name: Bram Eddows
source_profile:
Bram Eddows (LN) — Town Sheriff

Bram is a former river pilot and longtime resident of Westbridge who was elected sheriff shortly before the establishment of the marquisate. A broad-shouldered, deliberate man with a weathered face and an unremarkable manner, he is familiar with the practical difficulties of maintaining order in a bustling port where merchants, sailors, and travelers arrive from across the frontier.

Bram believes that Westbridge's prosperity depends upon the confidence of ordinary merchants and boatmen, not merely the influence of its wealthiest citizens. He has little patience for commercial disputes disguised as criminal complaints, and is particularly skeptical of those who expect the sheriff's office to enforce private contracts through intimidation.

His relationship with Sir Lorian Dace, captain of the River Spurs, is outwardly professional but increasingly strained. Bram acknowledges the Rangers' important role in protecting commercial shipping and pursuing dangerous outlaws, but resents their willingness to intervene in local investigations at the request of influential merchants. Lorian, meanwhile, regards the sheriff's insistence upon procedural fairness as an inconvenient obstacle to the efficient enforcement of Bellamy's authority.

Bram maintains a more cordial relationship with Tobin Sedge, whose experience as a river pilot and sympathy for independent boatmen closely resemble his own. The two men occasionally exchange information concerning suspicious vessels and criminal activity along the waterfront, although Tobin's obligations to the Rangers sometimes prevent him from sharing everything he knows.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 126 (source excerpt; may be partial)
